notes.title: Major Update: Deep Space Echoes
notes.notes:
- Reworked level progression: Each stage is no longer a continuous large map node but now features various stations scattered across a planet, each with its own functional stronghold. The Imperial Army's pursuit forces are now displayed more clearly.

Each stronghold may trigger special events, such as discovering rich mineral veins, electromagnetic interference, or vast open areas.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/8476329be5a500eb0a92f41f3e9089c6d0c43274.png"]

- Overhauled the Modification Factory and Resistance Center functions

Modification Factory: Can repair train durability, upgrade cards, and delete cards.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/91a943f3f1dc0786e61df9dce3e445ccf12efcf4.png"]

Resistance Center: Can purchase exclusive train upgrades.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/55627f73ce65a561f62cfc9593832e8446e53141.png"]

- Blueprint adjustments: Train modifications can now be adjusted directly from the train info panel.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/4b5fcd6366aa7a46a96ba02d16b6edccff6e6977.png"]

- Reworked most mercenary effects.

- Overhauled equipment cards, now functioning as permanent weapon upgrades.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/9a6c832b1370cd4d4f8bbf7c093b9c0225710c39.png"] 

- Reworked the unlock method for train-exclusive cards.

- Adjusted balance for most cards.

- Revised train storage rules: Exceeding capacity now requires discarding items to proceed.

- Core system adjustments: Once unlocked, cores can be freely selected in the base scene. Core usage no longer consumes energy, only requiring cooldown.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/53182f10c3d12608c71fd2d7bbcb8f388343d944.png"]

- Exploration system rework: Now divided into four dimensions—exploration item quantity, carry capacity, danger level, and max dispatch count. Each dimension has a cap, and assigning crew affects these values without exceeding limits.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/eaf67c3a6c36ed3e39978d1ef3e310620ee62011.png"]

- Reworked train selection screen, adding the Iron Fearless β model.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/6b9e9099a7347b310dd541696e4b79af88fe9930.png"]

- Frontline stronghold rework: Now grants starting buffs by spending Honor Points, which increase with game difficulty.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/f430c844183d88f1c26ca94d3a21af82f46802dc.png"]

- Train upgrade adjustments: Upgrades can now be performed anytime via the info panel, no longer requiring facility visits. Upgrades are obtainable from the Resistance Center and Research Lab.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/4697ff9504ca70baca7880ff4bfa5348c4dbcdd5.png"]

- New peripheral strongholds:

Forge: Can upgrade 1 weapon for free.

Research Lab: Can upgrade 1 train enhancement for free.

notes.title: Demo Update And Welcome Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! To welcome Steam Next Fest, we've prepared a plethora of content updates for the demo! Let's check it out.

Modification Factory
In the game, players can obtain a new type of card called "Carriage Blueprints" through various means. These cards do not occupy deck slots and do not affect the combat process. However, they can be used in the modification factory to upgrade carriages, thereby enhancing the train's combat effectiveness.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/0e0994cd63965ef3b735bb9f88dea867691ecf23.jpg

Gear Combination
Each "Carriage Blueprint" has two gear attributes. The higher the level of the same gear stacked, the stronger the effect you can obtain. The modification of carriages is full of strategy. Moreover, every time you acquire a "Carriage Blueprint," the gears are randomly generated, ensuring that each adventure is filled with surprises and fun.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/09b59004fff85f8ee018acec2d0c30a7dd72bff6.jpg

Train Enhancement
Each time you enter Modification Factory, five train enhancement options are available. Players can use resources to strengthen the train as needed to deal with a variety of enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/0ac6917afd32c3829418c9ffb8e5a18e053f330c.jpg

Peripheral Stronghold
The Peripheral Stronghold is the focus of this update. Now, a varying number of peripheral strongholds will be generated around each major stronghold. Each peripheral stronghold has different functions, which makes the route selection no longer singular.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210878/57316abfa79a359b0da66e2f1c50b219feab760b.jpg
Here are some of the peripheral strongholds:
Transit Station - A place where mercenaries gather.
Transfer Warehouse - Where you can accept cargo escort missions.
Repair Workshop - Where you can use resources to repair the train's durability.
Forge - Where you can use resources to enhance cards.
Dismantling Yard - Where you can use resources to remove 1 card.
Recycling Station - Where you can sell various goods.
Biomass Recovery Bay - Where you can treat injured mercenaries, which requires time.

Enemies
This demo added two new elite enemies and one new boss enemy.


Join the official game community to share your thoughts and don't forget to add the game to your wishlist on the Steam store page either~ It's very important to us. Thank you again for your support!
https://discord.gg/pHaphwxyEj
